scripts.generate: node scripts/python.mjs simulation/generate.py && node scripts/python.mjs -m simulation.platform
scripts.test:python: npm run test:workspace && npm run test:examples
scripts.test:examples: node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s simulation -t . -p test_*.py -v
scripts.test:research: node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s benchmarks -t . -p test_*.py -v
scripts.test:workspace: node scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ui
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
